'''The Bitter End''' was a frozen plain in the [[Icefall Plains/Legends|Icefall Plains]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. It contained several cave systems and during the [[Galactic War]], it was were an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] reclamation team, under [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Talos Drellik]], started [[Reclamation Service Hoth expedition|excavating]] hoping to find ancient ruins in the caves.
